issue_context.title: RegionInfo(4096) behaves differently depending on preceding method calls
comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @dotnet/area-system-globalization See info in [area-owners.md](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/area-owners.md) if you want to be subscribed.
Issue Details
### Description The documentation for [`RegionInfo(int culture)`](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.globalization.regioninfo.-ctor?view=net-6.0#system-globalization-regioninfo-ctor(system-int32)) says it will throw an `ArgumentException` when "`culture` specifies either an invariant, custom, or neutral culture." However, when passed a value of 4096 (LOCALE_CUSTOM_UNSPECIFIED) the constructor behaves differently depending on preceding method calls. ### Reproduction Steps ```cs using System; using System.Globalization; using System.Linq; if (args.Contains("get-cultures")) { CultureInfo.GetCultures(CultureTypes.SpecificCultures); } if (args.Contains("ai")) { new RegionInfo("ai"); } Console.WriteLine(new RegionInfo(4096).EnglishName); ``` ### Expected behavior I expect `new RegionInfo(4096)` to throw an `ArgumentException`, regardless of the preceding method calls. ### Actual behavior On my machine: If run without arguments, the program prints "Australia". If run with the argument "get-cultures", the program prints "Ethiopia". If run with the argument "ai", the program throws an `ArgumentException` with the message "Culture ID 4096 (0x1000) is a neutral culture; a region cannot be created from it. (Parameter 'culture')". ### Regression? _No response_ ### Known Workarounds _No response_ ### Configuration I have tested this on .NET 5 and .NET 6. ### Other information _No response_
